task.title: Resolving Merge Conflicts
task.shortdesc: Reconcile competing branch changes when target branch updates collide with proposed edits.

prereq.p: Merge conflicts occur when overlapping lines are modified independently across branches.

step.cmd: Fetch the latest changes from the default branch into your working environment.
Rebase or merge the target branch into your feature branch locally.
Open conflicting files, locate the conflict markers (<<<<<<<), and select the correct code or text block.
Stage the resolved files and complete the merge commit.
Push the updated branch history to update the active pull request automatically.
